Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Payment notice - two-leg wire for invoice LW-INV-4982

Hi Ben —

We issued payment today for LW-INV-4982 and LW-INV-4983. Bank routed the transfer as two legs: Leg A ($82,400.00) posted to your virtual-account reference 4072; Leg B ($18,600.00) posted to an intermediate clearing reference and is showing as "unapplied" on our end.

I attached the remittance scan and the bank stub for Leg A. Can you confirm receipt and provide the account mapping for the second leg so we can close the month? Also need VAT breakout for both invoices (LedgerWorks requires VAT proof for our records).

Attachments: remittance_scan_20261215.pdf (1 page), payment_stub_legA_20261215.csv

Paul —

Thanks for the heads up and for the attachments, got both. We see Leg A already applied to the virtual account 4072 and have matched LW-INV-4982. Leg B hasn’t been automatically matched on our side because the clearing reference doesn't include the invoice UTR, but it did arrive to our clearing bank earlier today.

Quick asks:
- Vanessa, can you pull the bank trace for the clearing reference and confirm beneficiary bank details?
- Laura, can you prepare VAT breakout for LW-INV-4982 and 4983 so I can send to Paul and LedgerWorks AP? LedgerWorks needs invoice-level VAT amounts and tax registration reference.

Paul, I’ll follow up once we have the trace and VAT table. If you can share the clearing reference number (if available), that will speed things up.

—Ben

Subject: RE: Payment notice - two-leg wire for invoice LW-INV-4982

Ben / team —

I pulled the bank trace this morning. Clearing reference from Paul (CLR-992772) corresponds to a CHAPS-like transfer that hit our intermediary on 2026-12-15 17:03 UTC and was posted to Account MISC-SWEEP (suspense) because the reference field was blank. Beneficiary bank: First Harbor (ACH/CHAPS routing).

I requested our bank to reclassify the item to Virtual Account 4072 pending remittance match; they provided a trace ID: TRC-RED-6120. I attached the bank trace PDF to the internal folder (link below).

Notes:
- If LedgerWorks can confirm invoice numbers on their remittance, we can force-apply Leg B to LW-INV-4983.
- If not, we should post as unapplied credit and send a short remittance request email to LedgerWorks with the unallocated amount and request invoice references.

Attachment stub: bank_trace_TRR-6120.pdf (internal)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xRemitEvidence

—Vanessa

Team —

Attached VAT table (pasted below). I pulled tax info from the invoices and the customer-supplied remittance fields. LedgerWorks is UK VAT-registered (GB999888777). I split VAT per invoice as requested.

LW-INV-4982 — Amount ex VAT: 82,000.00 USD — VAT (20% equiv): 16,400.00 USD — Total: 98,400.00 USD
LW-INV-4983 — Amount ex VAT: 18,000.00 USD — VAT (20% equiv): 3,600.00 USD — Total: 21,600.00 USD

We should confirm whether LedgerWorks expects VAT in GBP/converted amount. For their records they asked for invoice-level VAT and the tax registration number (included).

I also recommend we hold Leg B as unapplied for 2 business days before posting to 4983, in case of conflicting references; that gives AP time to confirm.

—Laura Bennett
